notes.title: Golf Peaks v3.60 (Nov 16th 2024) - main menu update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

This maintenance update for Golf Peaks is mostly aimed at improving the main menu which felt like it needed some love after all these years.

We've fixed the layouting for non-16:9 aspect ratios so that things are kept nice and center instead of weirdly stretching out for widescreen displays:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/653216cd2f9131e9f9f93af1c3c603a7e483e055.png

That nice key artwork we unveiled last year during Golf Peaks' 5th birthday celebration also looked a bit flat in the main menu so we reformatted the way it appears to make the main menu pop a bit more.

Patch notes for Golf Peaks v3.60:

 Improved main menu layout for aspect ratios other than 16:9,
 Improved main menu artwork display,
 Added a new section to the main menu with info about our other games,


Hope you keep enjoying Golf Peaks for years to come :)

Cheers,
Team at Afterburn

notes.title: Golf Peaks v3.50 (Nov 13th 2023) - 5th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
5th birthday
Golf Peaks launched 5 years ago! We can hardly believe that it's been so long since we released our tiny golf puzzle game, which kickstarted our journey into crafting cozy puzzle games for everyone to enjoy. To celebrate this milestone, we've prepared a large maintenance update for Golf Peaks and discounts on all of our games!

Check out the new key art!
The 5th anniversary of Golf Peaks sounded like the perfect opportunity to update the game's store visuals. To that end we've collaborated with an amazing Polish comic book artist - Tomasz Spell (https://kreskotok.blogspot.com/) - to create this brand-new illustration:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/c4fc5a977c5d61f1c81a1a06fcd4bc5b2cda69e3.jpg
You can click on the image above and download it as a 4K wallpaper if you'd like!

Golf Peaks - v3.50 - patch notes

Golf Peaks is now Deck Verified. 
 As part of this process we’ve improved gamepad controls, added display settings in the game & more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/383c172e637099c0f180afa9134bd96748786b25.png

Improved Options menu
 On PC/MacOS we’ve added display settings directly into the game to make it easier to change resolution & window settings,
 Settings that cycle through a list of options (like Language) now has arrows to allow navigation in two directions, making it easier to find what you’re looking for,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/157a231c02255d8c154a4b6b4a917c91c24dcedf.gif
 We’ve also added a Mute Audio button & a whole new Accessibility section!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/ddb913b991c4fc2516db5e5f5d8b82653ea1dc13.gif]

Added Accessibility options
 Reduced Motion Effects replaces camera transitions in the game with fades to make the game more pleasant for players prone to motion sickness,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/cbaebeec20f14c87a0d987ea765eb78946cbf575.gif
 Unlock All Levels makes a comeback from Railbound, allowing you to immediately jump into any level in the game without having to complete prior ones,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/b76093316fb2c2a8f630672d7f856e1fe9f21bf8.gif

Miscellaneous
 Added new key art to the main menu,
 Added a warning to the Clear Save panel,
 Updated Unity engine from version 2018 to 2021,
 Cleaned up old APIs to make the game more performant and lightweight,
 Inverted controls are now supported for keyboard & gamepad,
 Increased texture resolution for Afterburn logo in the intro scene,
 Added watermark with game version / build number in Main Menu,
 Fixed labels on certain buttons improperly wrapping text,
 Fixed label for “WORLD COMPLETE” message having an improper font weight,
 Added support for changing gamepads mid-gameplay,
 Added support for using scroll wheel in Credits,
 Added keyboard glyphs to several in-game buttons,
 Added keyboard prompts to game buttons,
 Added keyboard prompts to tutorials,
 Increased scroll wheel speed in Options,
 Fixed not being able to enter the hidden level when using Keyboard,
 Fixed grid layout for level buttons to avoid showing parts of buttons from the previous/next world,
 Fixed gameplay drag marker offset for non-16:9 displays,
 Updated Dutch localization,
 Updated in-game credits,
 Added keyboard shortcuts to main menu buttons,
 Updated Steamworks API,
 Improved cloud save synchronization between Windows, MacOS and Steam Deck,
Improved Credits artwork layout for displays wider than 16:9,

notes.title: Railbound - Birthday Update launches Sep 6th!
notes.content:
Hi!

Railbound's first birthday is just around the corner and we decided to celebrate it with a brand-new free update to the game!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42290292/1b0bed3cad611a7eb9d9b8f2168354dae2b98d59.png

On September 6th 2023 (next week!) get ready to solve over 40 new puzzles, try out the new mechanic - Two Locomotives - which remixes the default gameplay in fun new ways, and explore our most detailed Worlds yet! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQLGxM6Q6nY

Thanks for your support and see you next week :)

- Luke

notes.title: Next Fest demo is live now!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42290292/cc0744d35d3199ce5dddb307f4f63a2c6b901b97.png

Railbound is part of the Steam Next Fest - a festival of demos for upcoming games! From June 13th till 20th you can check out over a thousand pre-release titles, including our own!

To celebrate we released an updated demo featuring new puzzles and some long-awaited improvements. Check 'em out!

Patch notes for v0.56:

 five new levels (SP-1 to SP-5) showcasing a new mechanic,
 sliding the finger from a triple connection towards an unconnected side will now connect the two,
 creating triple connections on an existing corner should preserve the original direction,
 added VFX to cars and buttons,
 updated survey link, 


If you have any feedback you can let us know on our Discord and through the survey available in the game's main menu!

- Luke from Afterburn

notes.title: Next Fest demo coming next week!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42290292/225d5fea0bdc74b29e6ef63ef2d573a09a72f1e2.jpg


We hope that you enjoyed our current Railbound demo, because it's about to change a bit! (again!) From June 13th till 20th we're participating in the Steam Next Fest - a celebration of demos for upcoming games!

And we can't think of a better way to celebrate than by launching an updated version of the Railbound demo! In the new version you can expect a bunch of changes, including:


 five brand-new levels for you to try out - including a new mechanic,
 an updated input system that should make rail-bending easier (we hope!),
 additional fixes.


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42290292/68a2842ec81dd92aa14450ed0d7931116f996653.png

In order to put the updated content in spotlight, we will be removing the extra levels present in the current version (EX-1 to EX-6) and replacing them with the all-new puzzles (SP-1 to SP-5). 

This means that you only have until June 12th to check out the current levels before they're gone for good! (but will return in the full version...)

As always, we're super grateful to everyone who tried out the demo so far and we hope you'll check out these new puzzles & leave us feedback on our Discord and via the updated survey available in the game's main menu!

notes.title: inbento is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
If you enjoyed Golf Peaks, you'll probably like our other relaxing puzzle game that just arrived on Steam! 

inbento is a pattern-matching game about cooking up lovely Japanese boxed meals and features a cute story about parenthood. With over 120 puzzles to solve, an original soundtrack by the same crew behind Golf Peaks' music and a family of cats to enjoy, there's tons of fun to be had with the game.

[previewyoutube=3ecrtbR0qyo;full][/previewyoutube]

Furthermore, if you're a Golf Peaks owner you can get an additional discount thanks to our brand-new Afterburn Puzzle Bundle!

> Learn more about inbento!  Check out the Afterburn Puzzle Bundle! <
